title.en: An Act Authorizing and Confirming Certain Payments Made From the Road and Bridge Fund of the Province of Cebu By Eugene Garnett, Provincial Treasurer of Cebu, and By C. D. Upington, Acting Provincial Treasurer of the Same Province.

text.en:
The payments made from the road and bridge fund of the Province of Cebu by Eugene Garnett,
provincial treasurer of Cebu, amounting to sixteen thousand three hundred and sixty-nine pesos and
twenty-eight centavos, and by C. D. Upington, acting provincial treasurer of Cebu, amounting to twenty-eight
thousand and eleven pesos and seventy-one centavos, for the repair and construction of certain streets in the
municipality of Cebu, are hereby authorized and confirmed, the provisions of law to the contrary
notwithstanding.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the same shall take effect on its
passage, in accordance with the provisions of section one of Act Numbered Nineteen hundred and forty-five
of the Philippine Legislature.
Enacted, February 6, 1912.
